name: Golden Visage
description: Sculpt a living expression. A smile, raised brows, a wandering gaze.
hint: Drag across the mouth to shape a smile. Drag over the eyes to change gaze and expression.
author: maks

name: Quiet Ridges
description: Pull mountains out of paper. Move the sun through a landscape you shape.
hint: Drag up or down to sculpt lasting ridges. Choose Move sun to relocate the sun.
author: maks

name: Koi Letters
description: Draw with food. Three fish turn, follow the trail, and eat what you leave.
hint: Tap to drop food. Drag to leave a trail. Wait for the fish to find it.
author: maks

name: Seed & Bloom
description: Plant small possibilities. Water them, and watch a garden take its own shape.
hint: Choose Plant and tap for seeds. Choose Water and hold over them to grow flowers.
author: maks

name: Light Loom
description: Compose an aurora in layered ribbons. Stretch time with two fingertips.
hint: Drag to compose a ribbon. Use two fingers to stretch the moving light.
author: maks

name: Afternoon Tea
description: Pour, warm, and stir. Watch the cup fill and the steam respond.
hint: Hold above the cup to pour. Trace circles inside it to stir the tea.
author: maks

name: The Blue Cat
description: Earn a sleepy purr, or roll a ball of yarn just beyond a curious paw.
hint: Stroke the head in Pet mode. Choose Yarn and drag the ball for the paw to follow.
author: maks

name: Drifting Guests
description: Paint invisible currents. Jellyfish drift through the water you set in motion.
hint: Drag to paint a current. Tap for bioluminescence. Currents remain until you calm them.
author: maks

name: Thread by Thread
description: A loom remembers your hands. Lay colored threads and cross them into cloth.
hint: Draw across the loom to weave a thread. Change thread color, or undo one strand.
author: maks

name: Sand Ritual
description: Eight fine grooves follow your rake. Add stones and find a path around them.
hint: Drag in Rake mode to leave grooves. Choose Stone and tap to place a rock.
author: maks

name: A Place to Land
description: Offer a perch. A butterfly flutters toward it, then slowly opens its wings.
hint: Tap to grow a perch. Hold still to let the butterfly land. Drag to lead it elsewhere.
author: maks

name: Window Weather
description: Clear the mist with your hand. Let the glass gently cloud over again.
hint: Wipe the window with a drag. Cleared paths remain, then mist slowly returns.
author: maks

name: Velvet Groove
description: Scratch a record, release its momentum, and move the needle to another groove.
hint: Turn the record in a circle. Release to spin. Drag the tonearm to move the needle.
author: maks

name: Borrowed Autumn
description: A fast swipe becomes wind. Leaves fall, gather, and return with spring.
hint: Swipe quickly to shake leaves loose. Tap to regrow them. Try Autumn and Spring.
author: maks
mechanic: Wind impulses, falling leaves and regrowth

name: Phases of Quiet
description: Turn a moon through its phases. Leave small craters, and disturb its reflection.
hint: Swipe across the moon to change its phase. Tap for a crater; touch the water for a ripple.
author: maks
mechanic: Spherical phase shading and crater placement

name: Citrus Still Life
description: Slice along your own angle. Separate the halves and squeeze a little sunlight.
hint: Swipe across an orange to slice it. Switch to Squeeze and hold to release juice.
author: maks
mechanic: Stroke intersection, cutting and juice physics

name: A Fold, A Wish
description: Paper bends along its hinges. Fold both wings into a shape that stays.
hint: Drag either wing inward across its hinge. Two fingers can fold both wings together.
author: maks
mechanic: Independent paper hinges and retained folds

name: Pocket Universe
description: Place a black hole. Deepen it, move it, and watch stars find new orbits.
hint: Tap to create a gravity well. Hold to deepen it. Drag the well to reshape star orbits.
author: maks
mechanic: Persistent gravitational wells and orbital dynamics

name: Leave a Light On
description: Pull the cord and release. Slide over the shade to set the light you need.
hint: Pull the small cord downward and release to switch the lamp. Drag the shade to dim it.
author: maks
mechanic: Cord spring, switch and analog dimming

name: Paper Tides
description: Launch a paper boat. Steer it through waves made by your own hands.
hint: Tap to launch a boat. Drag it to steer; moving through water sends out waves.
author: maks
mechanic: Boat steering and propagating wave fields
